deeper_metadata.revision_intent: Improve alignment by closing the exact-H construction back to the original integral equation, proving both boundary faces required by the goals, preserving the core-consistent G exponent, and keeping the moment recurrence constructive rather than implicit.

rubric_interpretation.schema: The object uses only paper_title, contiguous deeper_reasoning_k string fields, and one deeper_metadata object.

rubric_interpretation.value_standard: High-value deeper reasoning should supply missing mathematical bridges: special-function-to-ODE verification, exact-H-to-differential-form closure, algebraic recovery of the original integral equation, endpoint compatibility, and lower-triangular moment construction.

deeper_reasoning_1.title: Exponent-selected hypergeometric verification for the auxiliary G equation
deeper_reasoning_1.goal_alignment: Verifies the hypergeometric auxiliary function against the linear G equation and explicitly controls the exponent mismatch between the core file and the goal extraction.
deeper_reasoning_1.scientific_payoff: Turns the exact-solution formula from an asserted special-function expression into a checked solution of the derived linear ODE.
deeper_reasoning_1.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: The core states the G formula and the G ODE separately; this entry proves compatibility and identifies the ODE-compatible exponent rather than assuming it.
deeper_reasoning_1.formal_sharpness: A general exponent r is carried through the transformation, producing an explicit residual whose vanishing selects the exponent.
deeper_reasoning_1.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejected a generic statement that hypergeometric functions solve hypergeometric equations; the entry performs the actual transformation and exponent audit.
deeper_reasoning_1.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The goal file contains a conflicting exponent. The entry mitigates this by proving the core exponent is required for the stated hypergeometric parameters and marking the other exponent as an upstream mismatch.

deeper_reasoning_2.title: Exact-H closure to Z0, the differential equations, and the original integral equation
deeper_reasoning_2.goal_alignment: Connects H=G/(G-2muG_mu) to Z0, the Riccati Z0 equation, the first-order H equation, and the original integral equation when Z0 is the stated integral transform.
deeper_reasoning_2.scientific_payoff: Closes the derivational loop from the solved linear equation back to the nonlinear equation that defines the target H function.
deeper_reasoning_2.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: The core proves pieces of the chain separately; this entry verifies that the exact H formula transports all required identities consistently.
deeper_reasoning_2.formal_sharpness: All cancellations are shown explicitly in terms of G, G_mu, G_mumu, and D=G-2muG_mu.
deeper_reasoning_2.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejected a proof that only re-derived the H differential equation; the entry also recovers the integral equation through Z0.
controlled_external_lemmas: algebraic equivalence of Z0 definition and integral equation
deeper_reasoning_2.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The recovery of the integral equation depends on the Z0 integral-transform identity, which is explicitly declared as a premise rather than smuggled into the proof.

deeper_reasoning_3.title: Boundary-face verification for H(mu,0) and H(0,omega)
deeper_reasoning_3.goal_alignment: Proves both boundary values named in the goal extraction: H(mu,0)=1 and H(0,omega)=1.
deeper_reasoning_3.scientific_payoff: Prevents the exact formula from being aligned only on the open domain while missing boundary conditions required by the target object.
deeper_reasoning_3.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Combines the omega=0 hypergeometric branch check with the mu-downarrow-zero endpoint argument, making boundary coverage explicit in one audit-facing derivation.
deeper_reasoning_3.formal_sharpness: The omega=0 branch is checked in the hypergeometric equation before evaluating G, and the H(0,omega) endpoint is bounded by a vanishing logarithmic term.
deeper_reasoning_3.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejected merely citing the boundary values from the goal file; both endpoint identities are derived.
deeper_reasoning_3.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The H(0,omega) endpoint proof uses boundedness, matching the condition already isolated in the core reasoning.

deeper_reasoning_4.title: Lower-triangular well-posedness of the moment recurrence
deeper_reasoning_4.goal_alignment: Transforms the convolution recurrence into the solved recurrence stated in the goals and proves that the denominator is positive over the full domain.
deeper_reasoning_4.scientific_payoff: Shows that all moments are recursively determined rather than merely constrained by an equation involving alpha_n on both sides.
deeper_reasoning_4.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: The core derives the convolution identity; this entry proves constructive uniqueness and removes the apparent singularity in alpha_0 at omega=0.
deeper_reasoning_4.formal_sharpness: Endpoint terms in the convolution are isolated, the coefficient is simplified to 4(n+sqrt(1-omega)), and strict positivity is proved.
deeper_reasoning_4.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejected listing alpha_1 and alpha_2 only; the proof establishes the full all-n mechanism.
deeper_reasoning_4.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The recurrence is formal in the same sense as the core moment derivation; the entry does not claim independent convergence beyond the source assumptions.
